sources.summary: Local studio Nitsche Arquitetos has updated two stations on São Paulo's Line 4-Yellow metro, paring back prior additions to reveal the structural elements and adding standardised timber elements. Seeing that years of accumulated signage and commercial elements had cluttered Pinheiros and Faria Lima stations, Nitsche Arquitetos set out to reorganise and streamline the visual language The post Nitsche Arquitetos integrates timber kiosks into São Paulo metro station renovations appeared first on Dezeen .
